+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from mkdocs.config.base import LegacyConfig
+from mkdocs.config import config_options as c
+from mkdocs.utils.yaml import ConfigDirPlaceholder
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("factory", [c.FilesystemObject, c.Dir, c.File])
+def test_pathlike_filesystem_option(factory, tmp_path):
+    target = tmp_path / "target"
+    if factory is c.Dir:
+        target.mkdir()
+    else:
+        target.write_text("content")
+    cfg = LegacyConfig((("path", factory(exists=True)),), config_file_path=str(tmp_path / "mkdocs.yml"))
+    cfg.load_dict({"path": Path("target")})
+    errors, warnings = cfg.validate()
+    assert errors == []
+    assert warnings == []
+    assert cfg["path"] == str(target)
+    assert isinstance(cfg["path"], str)
+
+
+def test_list_of_paths_accepts_lazy_placeholder(tmp_path):
+    (tmp_path / "assets").mkdir()
+    cfg = LegacyConfig((("paths", c.ListOfPaths()),), config_file_path=str(tmp_path / "mkdocs.yml"))
+    raw = ConfigDirPlaceholder(cfg, "assets")
+    cfg.load_dict({"paths": [raw, Path("assets")]})
+    errors, warnings = cfg.validate()
+    assert errors == []
+    assert warnings == []
+    assert cfg["paths"] == [str(tmp_path / "assets")] * 2
+
+
+def test_theme_accepts_pathlike_custom_dir(tmp_path):
+    (tmp_path / "custom").mkdir()
+    cfg = LegacyConfig((("theme", c.Theme()),), config_file_path=str(tmp_path / "mkdocs.yml"))
+    cfg.load_dict({"theme": {"name": None, "custom_dir": Path("custom")}})
+    errors, warnings = cfg.validate()
+    assert errors == []
+    assert warnings == []
+    assert cfg["theme"].dirs[0] == str(tmp_path / "custom")
+    assert isinstance(cfg["theme"].dirs[0], str)
+
+
+class BytesPath(os.PathLike):
+    def __fspath__(self):
+        return b"assets"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("theme", [False, True])
+def test_bytes_pathlike_is_validation_error(theme, tmp_path):
+    (tmp_path / "assets").mkdir()
+    option = c.Theme() if theme else c.Dir()
+    cfg = LegacyConfig((("value", option),), config_file_path=str(tmp_path / "mkdocs.yml"))
+    value = {"name": None, "custom_dir": BytesPath()} if theme else BytesPath()
+    cfg.load_dict({"value": value})
+    errors, _ = cfg.validate()
+    assert [key for key, _ in errors] == ["value"]
